calls.head: A shadow job for Carcone, McBain and Crouse
calls.body: At home, the Mammoth keep sending Crouse’s line (Carcone, McBain and Crouse) out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. André Tourigny has been using this group as a checking line on the other team’s top line. Tonight the Ducks’ first line is Gauthier, Carlsson and Caulfield.

surprises.head: Anaheim flipped the shot count
surprises.body: Utah throws more pucks at the net than almost anyone. Not tonight: Anaheim took 56 of the 90 shot attempts at 5-on-5. From how these two usually play, Anaheim would expect about 46%. A team strays this far about once every 70 games.
surprises.flipped: The Mammoth are going to test Ville Husso early and often

story.head: Cooley has a goal and an assist as the Mammoth edge the Ducks
paras: Leo Carlsson got the scoring started for the Ducks early in the first, but Vincent Trocheck tied it 1-1 for Utah midway through the period. Carlsson left early in the second period and didn’t return. The next day, he was listed as day to day with an upper-body injury. Andrew Peeke put the Mammoth ahead for good midway through the period, and Logan Cooley added the empty-netter with a little over a minute left to make it 3-1. Ian Moore cut Utah’s lead to 3-2 with 12 seconds left, but the Mammoth held on.

The Mammoth were outshot 31-12, but their looks were better, and the chances came out about even. Sebastian Cossa made 29 saves for the Mammoth, and Ville Husso stopped 9 of 11 at the other end. The Mammoth moved to 12-9-3, fifth in the Central, while the Ducks fell to 11-12-1, slipping to fourth in the Pacific.

items.text: The Ducks are on a three-game losing streak.
Vincent Trocheck has scored in three straight games.
The Mammoth won without Clayton Keller, Nate Schmidt, John Marino and others. Taking into account how much value each of these missing players usually adds, no team was missing more at the time.
Sam Colangelo was in NHL.com’s projected lineup, but Nico Myatovic played instead.
